title: Bound at a fixed radius: |∫_{M∩B_t} θ⟨dβ, ξ⟩ dHⁿ| ≤ s·liminf_{h→0+} h⁻¹μ{t − h < |x| < t} for every t < R
statement:
Let P, m ∈ ℕ, n := m + 1, U ⊆ ℝ^P, S ∈ 𝒟_n(U) (GeometricCurrentOn U n) and Rp = (M, θ, ξ) an integer multiplicity representation of S in U (IMRep U n with Rp.Represents S, Hⁿ = μHE[n]). Let R, t ∈ ℝ with closedBall(0, R) ⊆ U and t < R, and assume ∂S(ω) = 0 for every ω ∈ 𝒟^m(U) with tsupport ω ⊆ B_R(0) (open ball). Then for every β ∈ 𝒟^m(ℝ^P) (TestFormOn univ m) and every s ∈ ℝ with |β(x)| ≤ s for all x (|·| = covectorEuclideanNorm), in [0, ∞]:
  ENNReal.ofReal |∫_{M ∩ B_t(0)} θ(x)·⟨dβ(x), ξ(x)⟩ dHⁿ(x)| ≤ ENNReal.ofReal(s) · liminf_{h→0+} ENNReal.ofReal(h⁻¹)·μ({x : t − h < ‖x‖ < t}),
where μ = Rp.measure = (Hⁿ⌞M).withDensity θ, d = exteriorDerivative, ⟨dβ(x), ξ(x)⟩ = Rp.orient x (dβ x), and the liminf is taken along the filter 𝓝[>] 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)) (Rp : IMRep U (m + 1)) (R t : ℝ), closedBall (0 : Euclid P) R ⊆ U → Rp.Represents S → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U m, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) ⊆ ball 0 R → S.boundary ω = 0) → t < R → ∀ (β : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m) (s : ℝ), (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm ((β : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) x) ≤ s) → ENNReal.ofReal |∫ x in Rp.carrier ∩ ball 0 t, (Rp.mult x : ℝ) * Rp.orient x (exteriorDerivative (β : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) x) ∂μHE[m + 1]| ≤ ENNReal.ofReal s * liminf (fun h : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal h⁻¹ * Rp.measure {x : Euclid P | t - h < ‖x‖ ∧ ‖x‖ < t}) (𝓝[>] 0)
